title: feat(nm2readz): neighbor-read of M at t+1 on two-axis opposite z-probes: reverse fails, face HOLD
science: Two-axis opposite seed, z-probes, neighbor-read of M: fail at A, hold at B,C,D. Uses a different note template (Theorem/Proof/QED) from the rest of the band. The A failure is again the seed-letter convention: the partner seed (0,1,1) carries -e_2 against M(A)={+e_2}.
